decisions.decision: Database design gate PASSED: schema named `account`, additive SET SCHEMA migration, reversing Down, no index changes
decisions.why: Owner asked whether the account_account stutter could be avoided; the rename block is required for ANY non-public schema, so a different name buys nothing and breaks schema==module.

decisions.decision: No new to_regclass catalog test; rely on the existing account integration suite
decisions.why: A failed schema move makes every account query fail, so the existing suite already catches it. Matches the owner's no-extra-tests default.

decisions.decision: All 5 sub-tasks batched into ONE serial Sonnet worker instead of 3 dependency waves
decisions.why: Only T1/T2 and T4 are parallel-ok; 3 waves would re-read the doc pack 3x for a 4-file change. Serial order inside one dispatch respects every depends_on.

decisions.decision: Leader fixed the 6 unqualified raw SQL statements in service_integration_test.go directly, rather than re-dispatching the worker
decisions.why: Six mechanical sed edits with a deterministic grep check. A re-dispatch would re-read the whole doc pack to change six strings.
